- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Notable works of art in Musée des Beaux-Arts de Dijon: "The Raising of Lazarus" by Sebastiano del Piombo, "The Madonna and Child with St. John the Baptist and St. John the Evangelist" by Raphael, and "The Three Graces" by Peter Paul Rubens.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Notable works of art in Musée Magnin: "The Virgin Mary with Infant Christ in a Flower Garland" by Jan Breughel the Elder, "The Descent from the Cross" by Simon Vouet, and "Portrait of an Architect in His Office" by Jan Jansz van de Velde.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Notable works of art in Muséoparc Alésia: Replicas of Vercingetorix's helmet and statues of Julius Caesar and other Roman leaders.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Notable works of art in Musée d'Histoire de la Médecine et de la Pharmacie de Dijon: Old medical equipment and instruments, books, and documents.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Notable works of art in Maison Vougeot: Details the history of Burgundy wine and artifacts from the vineyards and cellars of local wine producers.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Notable works of art in Gallery Mazarine: A collection of contemporary art by different artists across France.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Notable works of art in Centre d'Art Contemporain La Vapeur: An exhibition of artworks by contemporary artists that experiment with digital forms of art.
